description: Source code for engine math calculations and engine control functions in a vehicle firmware project, including engine load computation, fuel scheduling, ignition mode handling, and engine cycle timing.

classes.name: FuelSchedule
classes.description: Class managing fuel injection events scheduling and fuel map configuration.

methods.name: getEngineCycleDuration
methods.description: Calculates duration of an engine cycle based on RPM and operation mode.

methods.name: getCrankshaftRevolutionTimeMs
methods.description: Returns milliseconds per crankshaft revolution based on RPM.

methods.name: getEngineLoadT
methods.description: Returns engine load value based on current fuel algorithm and sensors.

methods.name: setSingleCoilDwell
methods.description: Configures dwell times for single coil ignition systems.

methods.name: getSparkDwell
methods.description: Calculates spark dwell time based on RPM and engine state.

methods.name: getFiringOrderLength
methods.description: Returns number of cylinders in firing order based on configuration.

methods.name: getCylinderId
methods.description: Maps index to cylinder ID according to firing order.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionPinIndices
methods.description: Prepares ignition pin indices based on ignition mode.

methods.name: getCurrentIgnitionMode
methods.description: Determines current ignition mode, considering spin-up state.

methods.name: prepareOutputSignals
methods.description: Initializes engine output signals and trigger shape.

methods.name: setFuelRpmBin
methods.description: Sets RPM bins for fuel map.

methods.name: setFuelLoadBin
methods.description: Sets load bins for fuel map.

methods.name: setTimingRpmBin
methods.description: Sets RPM bins for ignition timing.

methods.name: setTimingLoadBin
methods.description: Sets load bins for ignition timing.

methods.name: setAlgorithm
methods.description: Configures fuel algorithm and ignition table scaling.
